content: Starfield plugins.txt at My Games/Starfield/Plugins.txt, asterisk-active format handled by libloadorder GameType::Starfield. 8 implicit base ESMs (Starfield.esm, Constellation.esm, OldMars.esm, BlueprintShips-Starfield.esm, SFBGS003/006/007/008.esm) are auto-active and NOT listed. New 'medium' plugin tier (0x400 flag, FDxxyyyy formIDs). Game REWRITES plugins.txt on launch: inserts Starfield.ccc entries at top, strips implicit ESMs. libloot/esplugin v6+ / libloadorder v17+ support Starfield.
